verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Items, Occurrences, Metrics and Deploys, plus item listing and filtering. Its own docs only claim coverage of "much of the data in the system", and nothing shows UI parity. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for UI actions such as grouping rules, merging, notification and integration setup, ownership and retention settings; an explicit parity statement; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Rollbar API provides a RESTful interface to much of the data in the system.
